REMOVAL OF CLUTCH UNIT

(7M-GE)
1. REMOVE TRANSMISSION
(See page MT-4)
HINT: Do not drain the transmission oil.

2. REMOVE CLUTCH COVER AND DISC
(a) Place the matchmarks on the clutch cover and
flywheel.
(b) Loosen each set bolt one turn at a time until spring
tension is released.
(c) Remove the set blots and pull off the clutch cover and
disc.
